title: Novel Knowledge-Guided Generative Methods for Synthetic Transcriptomic Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.13256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As biomedical research increasingly relies on data-intensive tools, the quality and utility of datasets are critical. Challenges such as imbalances, biases, and ethical or legal constraints often limit access to high-quality data. Synthetic data generation can help overcome these limitations. Here, we present a comparative analysis of generative models for transcriptomic data, investigating strategies to incorporate prior biological knowledge via gene graphs. This ensures that synthetic data capture real-world gene patterns, maintaining their usefulness for downstream tasks. In particular, we introduce and benchmark three variants of the Generative Adversarial Network. Among the alternatives, MK-TGAN - an innovative multi-kernel, Graph Neural Network-based model - stands out for its performance in terms of both the realism and utility of the generated data. translated_title: 新型知识引导的合成转录组数据生成方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：随着生物医学研究越来越依赖数据密集型工具，数据集的质量和实用性变得至关重要。不平衡、偏差以及伦理或法律限制等挑战常常限制了对高质量数据的获取。合成数据生成有助于克服这些限制。在此，我们提出了对转录组数据生成模型的比较分析，研究了通过基因图整合先验生物学知识的策略。这确保了合成数据能够捕捉真实的基因模式，保持其在下游任务中的实用性。特别地，我们引入并评估了生成对抗网络的三种变体。在这些替代方案中，MK-TGAN——一种创新的多核、基于图神经网络的模型——在生成数据的真实性和实用性方面表现出色。与其他方法不同，MK-TGAN通过利用先验知识图来提升性能。
tldr: 本文提出并比较了多种生成模型，其中MK-TGAN通过利用基因图整合先验生物学知识，在合成转录组数据的真实性和实用性方面表现最优。
en_tdlr: This paper compares generative models for transcriptomic data, highlighting MK-TGAN, which leverages gene graphs to integrate prior biological knowledge, achieving superior realism and utility in synthetic data generation.
